title: The pros and cons of self-directed learning

cues.en: It is very possible that you are watching this video, not because you have to, because it's a core
cues.zh: 你很可能不是因為必須看，因為這是高中或大學課程的核心

cues.en: part of your high school or university course, but because you want to because you want to learn calculus.
cues.zh: 內容，而是因為你想看、想學微積分，才在看這支影片。

cues.en: Maybe you're unsatisfied with the resources assigned by your university course, or maybe you're learning
cues.zh: 也許你不滿意大學課程指定的資源，也許你學

cues.en: calculus in order to understand data science or machine learning or, you know, maybe you're just curious and you enjoy learning new things and you want to learn calculus with Python.
cues.zh: 微積分是為了理解資料科學或機器學習，也許只是好奇、喜歡學新東西，想搭配 Python 學微積分。

cues.en: The point is, you are here because you want to be here.
cues.zh: 重點是，你在這裡，是因為你想在這裡。

cues.en: That makes you a self directed learner, an autodidact, and that brings its own unique set of challenges and also opportunities.
cues.zh: 這讓你成為自主學習者、自學者，而這會帶來一套獨特的挑戰與機會。

cues.en: And actually learning on your own is amazing.
cues.zh: 其實自己學習很棒。

cues.en: That's actually my favorite way to learn things.
cues.zh: 這是我最喜歡的學習方式。

cues.en: When you learn on your own, you can learn what you want, when you want and how you want.
cues.zh: 自學時，可以自己決定學什麼、何時學、如何學。

cues.en: And if you don't like a particular teacher or a particular textbook, then you know what?
cues.zh: 如果不喜歡某個老師或某本教科書，你知道嗎？

cues.en: Screw it.
cues.zh: 管它的。

cues.en: Just find a better one that works for you.
cues.zh: 找個更適合你的就好。

cues.en: You can't do that in a university course, but there is a downside.
cues.zh: 大學課程可不能這樣，不過這也有缺點。

cues.en: It's harder to keep up the motivation to learn on your own, whether it's from a book or an online course.
cues.zh: 不管從書本還是線上課程，自學都比較難維持學習動機。

cues.en: And there actually is something really beneficial about being in a university course with an instructor
cues.zh: 大學課程裡有老師、

cues.en: and teaching assistants, not to mention other students that you can go to when you need help or when you want to study with other people.
cues.zh: 助教，更別說還有同學，需要幫忙或想和別人一起學時，都可以找他們，這確實很有好處。

cues.en: And you also usually don't get grades or official credit for learning on your own.
cues.zh: 而自學通常也拿不到成績或正式學分。

cues.en: I mean, if you go through this course, you get a certificate from Udemy, which is cool and whatever.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，上完這門課，你會得到 Udemy 證書，這很酷之類的。

cues.en: But you know, that's not something you can show to your university and get official credit for.
cues.zh: 但你不能拿給大學，換取正式學分。

cues.en: And let's be honest, having a few course completion certificates from Udemy is not exactly the same as having a master's degree when you go for job interviews.
cues.zh: 坦白說，找工作面試時，幾張 Udemy 完課證書，和碩士學位並不是同一回事。

cues.en: So that's the bad side there.
cues.zh: 這就是不好的一面。

cues.en: Also, you know, let's be honest here, there's also an ugly side, and learning on your own can make you feel lonely or isolated.
cues.zh: 老實說，還有更難受的一面：自學可能讓你覺得孤單、孤立。

cues.en: It might make you question why you're even learning this stuff in the first place instead of relaxing and watching a movie.
cues.zh: 你可能會懷疑，為什麼要學這些，而不是放鬆看電影。

cues.en: And, you know, when you're struggling with something, which we all do, then if you're learning on your own, you might start to feel like you're stupid or you can't do it.
cues.zh: 而遇到困難時，我們每個人都會遇到，如果你是自學，就可能開始覺得自己很笨、做不到。

cues.en: Now everyone has these kinds of feelings and some people experience some more than others.
cues.zh: 每個人都有這類感受，有些人經歷得比別人多。

cues.en: Some people are more bothered by those feelings than others.
cues.zh: 有些人也比別人更受這些感受困擾。

cues.en: That's just how it is, you know, It's part of being human.
cues.zh: 事情就是這樣，這也是身為人的一部分。

cues.en: And really one of the main drivers of these difficulties here of self directed learning is how hard it is to stay accountable when you are learning on your own.
cues.zh: 自主學習這些困難的主要原因之一，其實是自己學習時，很難對自己負責、持續履行承諾。

cues.en: So let me now say a few words about accountability.
cues.zh: 所以現在，讓我談談學習責任。

cues.en: Accountability in learning means that you take responsibility for learning, and accountability also means that there are real consequences for not taking responsibility.
cues.zh: 學習中的責任，表示你對學習負責，也表示，如果沒有負起責任，會有實際後果。

cues.en: Now in school, the consequences are obvious if you don't learn, you get a bad grade.
cues.zh: 在學校，後果很明顯：不學，就拿到爛成績。

cues.en: And so accountability is really important concept in education.
cues.zh: 所以學習責任在教育裡，是個很重要的概念。

cues.en: It helps keep you motivated to continue learning.
cues.zh: 它能幫你維持動機，繼續學習。

cues.en: And that's also super duper important for self directed learning because it is surprisingly difficult to keep up the motivation when learning on your own.
cues.zh: 對自主學習也非常重要，因為自學時要維持動機，出乎意料地困難。

cues.en: And it's kind of weird when you think about it, right?
cues.zh: 想想也滿奇怪的，對吧？

cues.en: I've always found this really strange.
cues.zh: 我一直覺得很奇怪。

cues.en: I mean, you are you, you tell yourself that you want to learn, and yet it's really hard to keep going even though you really want to.
cues.zh: 你就是你，告訴自己想學，但即使真的想，還是很難持續下去。

cues.en: Well, you know, that's also understandable.
cues.zh: 不過，這也可以理解。

cues.en: Most of us have busy lives and other things to do in our life, like school and work, family, friends,
cues.zh: 大多數人生活忙碌，還有很多事要做，像上學、工作、家庭、朋友、

cues.en: traveling, hobbies, maybe the occasional sleeping and relaxing and so on.
cues.zh: 旅行、嗜好，也許偶爾還得睡覺、放鬆等等。

cues.en: It's not always so easy to make time for learning something new, especially when it's challenging and when you don't need to really learn it or don't have that social accountability.
cues.zh: 要騰出時間學新東西，不總是容易，尤其內容很有挑戰性，又不是非學不可，或缺乏來自他人的督促時。

cues.en: Anyway, the conclusion of all this is that self directed learning should be as easy as having the motivation to learn.
cues.zh: 總之，結論是，自主學習照理應該只要有學習動機，就能輕鬆做到。

cues.en: But the reality is that it's hard.
cues.zh: 但現實是，它很難。

cues.en: It's hard to stay focused and it's hard to stay motivated.
cues.zh: 很難維持專注，也很難維持動機。

cues.en: And anyone tells you that it isn't hard.
cues.zh: 如果有人說這不難，

cues.en: Well, that's someone who's never tried it before.
cues.zh: 那他一定從來沒有試過。

cues.en: It's hard for me, too, by the way.
cues.zh: 順便說，對我也很難。

cues.en: So here's the thing about accountability.
cues.zh: 所以關於學習責任，是這樣的。

cues.en: When you're learning in a traditional educational setting, like a high school or university course,
cues.zh: 在傳統教育環境，例如高中或大學課程中學習，

cues.en: you have multiple sources of external and internal accountability to keep you motivated, to keep you going, keep you learning.
cues.zh: 你有多種來自外部與內部的責任來源，讓你維持動機，持續前進、持續學習。

cues.en: You have friends or classmates or work colleagues.
cues.zh: 有朋友、同學或同事。

cues.en: You have the motivation to get good grades.
cues.zh: 也有想拿好成績的動機。

cues.en: Maybe you have a family that is pressuring you to get good grades, or maybe your employer is paying for your education and they expect good performance.
cues.zh: 家人可能會要求你拿好成績，或者雇主支付你的教育費用，期待你有好表現。

cues.en: And of course, part of the accountability is internal.
cues.zh: 當然，一部分責任來自內在。

cues.en: It comes from you.
cues.zh: 來自你自己。

cues.en: You just want to learn.
cues.zh: 你就是想學。

cues.en: But what happens when it's only you at home with your laptop and your notebook and your pencil?
cues.zh: 但如果只有你一個人在家，帶著筆電、筆記本和鉛筆，會怎麼樣？

cues.en: What gives you the accountability?
cues.zh: 是什麼讓你對學習負責？

cues.en: Well, obviously, this last one certainly applies and maybe some of these other ones as well.
cues.zh: 顯然，最後這一項一定適用，也許其他某些項目也適用。

cues.en: Now, this is going to differ for each person.
cues.zh: 每個人的情況都不同。

cues.en: Each learner is different, but I'm sure we all agree that there are fewer sources of external pressure,
cues.zh: 每個學習者都不一樣，但我相信大家都同意，自學時，外在壓力、

cues.en: external accountability when trying to learn on your own compared to learning in a more traditional classroom or group setting.
cues.zh: 外部督促的來源，比傳統教室或團體學習少。

cues.en: So the point is that it helps to have some strategies, some tools for holding yourself accountable to keep up the learning.
cues.zh: 所以重點是，採取一些策略、工具，讓自己對持續學習負責，會有幫助。

cues.en: And in the next video, I'm going to make some specific suggestions about how to hold yourself accountable.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，我會給一些具體建議，說明如何做到。

cues.en: But what I'd like you to do after watching this video is take a moment to reflect on this issue of accountability.
cues.zh: 不過看完這支影片後，我想請你花點時間，反思學習責任這個問題。

cues.en: How important is it to you?
cues.zh: 對你有多重要？

cues.en: Is it something you think about or worry about?
cues.zh: 你會思考或擔心這件事嗎？

cues.en: Or maybe you don't worry about it at all?
cues.zh: 還是完全不擔心？

cues.en: Is it difficult for you to keep up the motivation and keep working?
cues.zh: 對你而言，維持動機、持續努力，困難嗎？

cues.en: Are there any tricks that you use or that you can recommend to other people?
cues.zh: 你有什麼自己使用，或能推薦給別人的技巧？

cues.en: If you like, you can post a reply to the Q&A for this lecture, but that's not necessary.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以在這堂課的問答區回覆，但不是必要的。

cues.en: Mostly, I just want to bring up this issue because I believe that it's really important and I encourage
cues.zh: 主要是我相信這個問題很重要，所以想提出來，也鼓勵

cues.en: you to think about this issue of personal accountability and keeping up the motivation to learn in self directed learning.
cues.zh: 你思考自主學習中，對自己負責，以及維持學習動機的問題。
